newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares spurt higher, ITC leads the way.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares spurt higher, ITC leads the way.

text.p: Delhi shares, led by cigarette maker ITC, surged in brisk early trade on Monday on expectations of strong 1996/97 (April-March) corporate results, brokers said.
After 30 minutes of trade, the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 5.01 points to 784.88.
ITC added 10.50 rupees to 451.50, boosted by strong buying by foreign institutional investors and short-covering. The Calcutta-based firm is to announce its 1996/97 results on Tuesday.
"The market is showing a rising trend on hopes that corporates will come out with better than expected working results," said Harjit Wadhwa of stockbrokers Wadhwa and Associates.
Reliance Industries jumped 1.25 rupees to 296.20 on speculative purchases.
TISCO gained 1.70 rupees to 178.55, bolstered by financial institution's purchases.
State Bank of India rose 2.10 rupees to 307.10.
Larsen and Toubro edged up 1.45 rupees to 215.
